sourceRig.finding: The partial Mixamo skin is not usable for runtime deformation: all seven meshes are weighted overwhelmingly to mixamorig:Hips; the arm and leg joints have no useful distributed weights.

existingGameSet.name: Copper
existingGameSet.runtimeStatus: All five items are present in game/public/assets/manifest.json with tripo-armor-approved tags. Existing import metadata records native male runtime fitting, copper PBR review, and normal-camera movement review.

reason: This starred export is another export of the already integrated Copper/Grithe armor project. It has the same total and per-mesh triangle counts as the existing static source, while its rig weights are unusable and its base-color maps are 128 to 1024 px rather than 8K. The existing static export was segmented and rebound to the game's 65-joint player skeleton, retaining the 3945-triangle source geometry. A new parallel armor set would duplicate the same authored look. No new candidate GLBs or lab catalog are staged.
